root_causes.evidence: db().commit() was commented out (PERF-412), so POST /orders returned 201 after charging but never persisted the order. The ledger showed pay_9a9dddb90d and pay_293df89528 charged with no matching order rows.

report.summary: Checkout charged customers and returned 201, but the order insert was never committed because the commit line was commented out. I restored db().commit() in app.py (human-approved) and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests now pass, and checkout persists the order. Charges made before the fix (pay_293df89528, pay_9a9dddb90d, both 85.0, plus any earlier smoke-test charges) have no order rows. I did not invent data for them. A human should reconcile them with the payments ledger, either by refunding or by recreating the orders.
